usage: deskops desk replace [-h] [--root ROOT] --old OLD --new NEW
                            [--count COUNT]
                            path

positional arguments:
  path           Path of the file under desk/ (desk/... or relative to the
                 desk root).

options:
  -h, --help     show this help message and exit
  --root ROOT    Target repository root.
  --old OLD      Exact text to replace; must occur --count times.
  --new NEW      Replacement text.
  --count COUNT  Exact number of occurrences of --old to require (default: 1).
